## Outcome

## Safety review

- [ ] The change does not stash, reset, clean, force-update, merge, or push.
- [ ] Concurrent index, ref, lock, path, hook, and crash behavior was considered.
- [ ] New state has a bounded and fail-closed reader.
- [ ] Tests cover the failure boundary.
